Structural variant junction track

Source: R/geom-junction.R
geom_junction.Rd

Draws structural variant junctions as arcs between their two breakpoints. Pair with coord_loci() to connect breakpoints in different windows, including trans junctions between chromosomes, or coord_genome() for a genome-wide view. A junction with one breakpoint out of view is drawn as a stub at the breakpoint in view, labeled with the chromosome of its partner.

x and xend default to the start1 and start2 columns of BEDPE data, as from devgru::read_bedpe_file(output_type = "dt"). On its own, the track draws arcs up from the bottom of the panel, or down from the top, taller for junctions spanning more of the axis. To draw junctions on a copy number track, map y and yend to the copy number at each breakpoint, e.g. from junction_copy_number(), and arcs connect those heights.

Usage

geom_junction(
  mapping = NULL,
  data = NULL,
  arc_height = NULL,
  arc_direction = c("up", "down"),
  scale_by_span = TRUE,
  arc_shape = c("arch", "strand"),
  partner_label_size = 2.5,
  breakpoint_marks = FALSE,
  ...,
  na.rm = FALSE,
  show.legend = NA,
  inherit.aes = TRUE
)

Arguments

mapping

Set of aesthetic mappings created by ggplot2::aes(), e.g. colour = type, or y and yend to anchor arcs at copy number.

data

Data frame of junctions with seqnames1, start1, seqnames2, and start2 columns.

arc_height

Height of the tallest arcs as a fraction of the panel height. Default: 0.9 on their own, 0.25 when y is mapped.

arc_direction

Draw arcs "up" (default) or "down" from their breakpoints.

scale_by_span

Make arcs spanning more of the axis taller, default: TRUE

arc_shape

Shape of the arcs. "arch" (default) draws symmetric arches; "strand" draws arcs leaving each breakpoint toward the side it joins, from the strand1 and strand2 columns, as in gTrack: deletion-like junctions arch inward, duplication-like junctions loop outward, and inversions hook to one side, so short fold-back inversions show as hooks. Stubs lean the same way.

partner_label_size

Size of the partner chromosome labels on stubs in mm, or 0 for none. Default: 2.5

breakpoint_marks

Mark each breakpoint with a short tick pointing to the side it joins, from the strand1 and strand2 columns, as in PCAWG figures. Default: FALSE

...

Other arguments passed to ggplot2::layer(), e.g. colour, linewidth, or alpha.

na.rm, show.legend, inherit.aes

See ggplot2::layer().

Value

List of a ggplot2 layer and, unless y is mapped, a y-axis scale and title, added to a plot with +

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
junctions <- devgru::read_bedpe_file("sample.jabba.junctions.bedpe", output_type = "dt")
windows <- c(MYC = "chr8:126000001-130000000", IGH = "chr14:105000001-107000000")

ggplot2::ggplot(junctions) +
  geom_junction(ggplot2::aes(colour = type)) +
  scale_colour_sv_type() +
  coord_loci(windows) +
  theme_genomic()

# Junctions joining copy number segments
ggplot2::ggplot() +
  geom_copy_number(data = cn, cn_cap = 8) +
  geom_junction(data = junction_copy_number(junctions, cn, cn_cap = 8),
                ggplot2::aes(y = cn1, yend = cn2, colour = type)) +
  scale_colour_sv_type() +
  coord_loci(windows) +
  theme_genomic()
} # }
